title: Audio Engineer- Summit
description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com .

Live Nation’s Concerts Division is where tours are born, artists come to life, and fans get to experience the rush of live music. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. With perks ranging from free concert tickets to dog-friendly offices, to progressive benefits like student loan reimbursement and adoption/fertility support... it’s no wonder we are certified as a Great Place to Work organization and one of People Magazine’s “50 Companies that Care”. We want everyone to feel like they belong and can thrive in our community, so we strive to help you achieve your career and personal goals. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Performs the Load-in & Out of band equipment and rental equipment

Set Up and Break down of Band and Event Equipment

Cabling and patching / working together with the entire crew as a team

Audio adjustments, maintaining safe audio levels. While providing a professional mix

Audio Control Boards operation

Oversee visiting audio techs, especially during shows

Responsible for Protecting /Maintenance and repair of Audio equipment

Assist with Production throughout the House as needed

Assist the Production Manager with the technical advance with Artists representatives

Ensure proper care and handling of all Company and rental audio equipment

Interact with visiting production crews to ensure a successful show

Distribute or create audio plans

Oversee and operate systems pertaining to audio throughout the entire venue

Ensure Special Events audio needs are scheduled and met and executed with the utmost profession attitude

Maintain a relationship with local & National Audio Vendors Maintenance and repair of sound, light and stage equipment

May assist the Stage Manager with show passes

Assist lighting crew with stands, microphones, cables, etc.

Assist with any Special Events operations

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

Required:

3 years minimum Tour and Stage Production experience

Experience in stage lighting, pro audio systems and basic video systems

Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously

Proficiency with all Microsoft applications

Must possess superior interpersonal communication and organizational skills

High School Diploma

Preferred:

College Degree

Physical Demands/Working Environment:

Must be able to lift up to 75 lbs

Work in an environment with moderate to loud noise level

title: Senior Engineer, Application Systems Development
description:
Overview

Are your development skills ready for pro audio?

As a Senior Engineer, Application Systems Development (Application Security) , you'll design, develop, debug, test, and document full-stack security solutions and application features for our platform independent (Windows, OS X, Linux) GUI applications software across all development phases. Advance the evolution of our software design and how it integrates with embedded firmware systems in professional audio products, both in wired and wireless contexts. You'll collaborate with security analysts to understand the existing state of software solutions and be expected to evaluate, research, and improve solutions to enhance our security posture. You'll also collaborate with other divisions, such as Sales and Marketing, to establish use cases, define requirements for application behaviors, and software tests.

This role is a remote or hybrid position, reporting to our Niles, IL HQ.

Responsibilities

Design and implement platform independent GUI application software and security solutions that controls and manages cutting edge audio products and networking technologies on cross functional teams

Collaborates with marketing, test, and system engineering to define platform independent GUI application software use cases and requirements

Prototypes application software using the technologies listed in the qualifications below

Collaboratively drives decisions in architecture, design, and development of platform independent GUI application software, with an emphasis on security solutions

Review and refine integration test plans for GUI, API, and company proprietary (embedded systems) software

Researches and advises on adoption of improved ways of developing our software throughout the software development lifecycle, and its development processes, with an emphasis on security

Integrates and tests proprietary and non-proprietary networking communication protocols in platform independent GUI application software including common physical, datalink, network and transport layer protocol standards

Reviews designs and code developed by other engineers to evaluate and guarantee software quality and application security

Mentors other software engineers on refining their craft in the qualifications listed below

Estimates, organizes, and documents tasks

Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in application development, with a strong portfolio of successfully delivered projects with significant solution ownership demonstrated throughout the entire software development lifecycle

Proven front end expertise in one or more Single Page Application frameworks (Angular preferred), TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, HTML5, and CSS3.

Proven back end expertise in Node.js (TypeScript), and Electron, authoring APIs, designing and implementing algorithms, and evaluating solution security with front end integrations

Understanding of operating system fundamentals, reactive programming, multi-threading, and how async code executes in TypeScript

Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities both independently and in groups, with a positive attitude and team player mentality

Understanding of industry standard software development practices, such as: -- Software Design Patterns and Principles, such as separation of concerns, cohesion vs coupling, SOLID -- Unit and Integration Testing (preferred with Jasmine or Jest) -- Continuous integration, testing, and deployment

Experience with the following technologies are strongly preferred: -- Version Control Systems, such as git, bitbucket, and SVN, along with git clients such as Sourcetree, Bitbucket -- WebSockets and realtime asynchronous programming -- Front end experience with Nx monorepos / NRWL and Angular Material -- Integrating and authoring GraphQL schemas (Queries, Mutations, Subscriptions) -- Domain experience as an end user or developer of audio products or wireless radio products -- Implementing authentication and authorization subsystems -- Computer Networking -- Distributed Systems -- Developing Node.js native add-ons -- Software Project Management Tools (JIRA, Confluence) -- Familiarity with Integrated Development Environments (e.g. Visual Studio Code)

Works effectively in a remote-first-by-design agile software development culture that embraces hybrid work and/or travel opportunities to physical sites, based on project needs and team collaboration

Effective verbal and written communication skills for working with technical and non technical business functions across globally distributed teams

Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Shure will not sponsor applicants for this position for work visas.

WHO WE ARE

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

Join Shure and Amplify Your Impact. Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

THE MIX MATTERS Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply! PAY TRANSPARENCY Shure offers a competitive compensation structure that is reviewed annually to attract, hire, and retain the industry’s top talent. Base salaries vary based on qualifications, geography, experience, and expertise in each respective discipline. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base salary for the opportunity. The base salary for this position ranges from $115,600 to $185,000, with a midpoint target. If your salary expectations do not align, still apply as we are often flexible on the seniority of posted positions. All positions also include an award-winning benefits package.

WE GOT YOU - Our Benefits At Shure, we prioritize the well-being of our Associates. We offer competitive rewards packages to full-time and part-time Associates working 24 or more hours a week that address physical, mental, financial, and overall well-being. Our benefits include comprehensive healthcare, mental health and retirement savings plans, generous paid time off programs, employee discounts, professional development opportunities, work-life balance initiatives, employee recognition programs, and volunteering/community involvement opportunities. To learn more, check out our Benefits At A Glance.

title: Luxury Events and Property Management Lead, House of Sound
description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

House of Sound is the flagship expression of Bose Luxury—a living, immersive environment where sound, design, and culture come together to define a new standard for luxury audio.

More than a showroom, House of Sound is a brand beacon and cultural platform—designed to attract new luxury audiences, inspire desire, and demonstrate the emotional and experiential power of McIntosh and Sonus faber.

The Luxury Events and Property Management Lead is responsible for operating, curating, and elevating this space—ensuring that it delivers exceptional daily experiences while also establishing House of Sound as a relevant destination within the luxury and cultural landscape of New York City.

This role blends operational excellence, cultural programming, and client experience—ensuring the House is both flawlessly run and continuously evolving.

Roles & Responsibilities

House of Sound Operations & Facility Excellence

- Ensure luxury-level standards across presentation, cleanliness, and systems
- Manage vendors, maintenance, and day-to-day operations

Programming, Cultural Partnerships & Brand Elevation
- Develop and manage a dynamic programming calendar
- Recruit tastemakers, cultural leaders, and luxury partners
- Establish House of Sound as a destination within NYC luxury ecosystem

Guest Experience, Hospitality & Listening Excellence
- Oversee hospitality team and guest journey
- Coordinate audio / training specialists to deliver exceptional demos
- Ensure high-quality, emotionally engaging listening experiences

Brand Environment & Spatial Storytelling
- Develop brand-specific and cross-brand environments
- Partner with Creative to evolve spatial storytelling
- Recruit partners to enhance aesthetics and functionality

Client Engagement, Tours & Sales Enablement
- Host VIP visits, tours, and demonstrations
- Support dealer-led sales through high-quality experiences
- Create environments that drive desire and conversion

External Representation & Brand Ambassadorship
- Build relationships across luxury, design, and cultural communities
- Represent House of Sound at external events and experiences
- Extend brand presence beyond the physical space

Cross-Functional Coordination
- Partner with Product & Property Marketing, Activation, Training, and Creative
- Ensure alignment, planning, and execution across all initiatives

Performance Tracking & Optimization
- Track event effectiveness, guest engagement, and sales influence
- Identify opportunities to improve programming and experience

Experience & Skills

- 8–12+ years in luxury retail, hospitality, experiential, or cultural programming
- Experience managing high-end spaces and event programming
- Strong network or ability to engage tastemakers and partners
- Experience delivering VIP client experiences
- Strong operational and leadership capabilities

#LI-SS1

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of New York, New York is: $119,500-$164,350.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.

In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. title: Staff Data Engineer, Audio Content & Dataset Science (Skywalker Sound)
description: Staff Data Engineer, Audio Content & Dataset Science (Skywalker Sound) Job ID 10164953 Location Nicasio, California, United States Business Skywalker Sound Date posted Nov. 12, 2026 Staff Data Engineer, Audio Content & Dataset Science (Skywalker Sound) Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements The Skywalker Sound Development Group is seeking an experienced Staff Data Engineer to lead the end-to-end strategy, creation, management, and optimization of audio content datasets to drive state-of-the-art AI/ML research. In this role, you will take principal ownership of building, curating, and balancing high-quality audio datasets tailored for the training, retraining, and evaluation of machine learning models in immersive and multichannel audio applications. As a Staff Data Engineer, you will focus on developing scalable pipelines to process complex media content, while actively analyzing and balancing datasets relative to model performance for speech processing, style transfer, and source separation. Your expertise in audio content and dataset lifecycle management will directly empower AI/ML researchers to build transformative soundtrack workflows for global media production. This role is considered Hybrid, which means the employee will be based in the Bay Area and work onsite in our Skywalker Sound office in Nicasio and occasionally from home. What you'll do: Take principal ownership of creating, curating, and managing high-volume audio content datasets to fuel AI/ML model training, retraining, and evaluation. Design scalable data pipelines for the ingestion, preprocessing, and continuous transformation of large-scale, complex audio content. Analyze, balance, and fine-tune dataset compositions relative to model performance metrics, mitigating bias and ensuring optimal generalization across AI/ML training iterations. Develop advanced preprocessing techniques for immersive and multichannel audio formats (e.g., Dolby Atmos, high-order ambisonics). Automate data cleaning, normalization, and augmentation processes to prepare datasets for various model architectures, including foundational models and transformers. Integrate external datasets and APIs while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical data usage standards. Monitor and optimize pipeline performance to handle complex and dynamic data structures effectively. Create tools and workflows for annotating, labeling, and curating datasets, including the use of active learning methods. Perform exploratory data analysis and continuous dataset audit logs to uncover distribution imbalances, validate content quality, and resolve critical data coverage gaps. What you'll need: Master’s Degree with preference for PhD in Data Engineering/Science, Computer Science, Signal Processing, or a related field. 8+ years of data engineering or data science experience, with a heavy emphasis on handling complex audio/media content and owning ML training datasets. Proficiency in Python, with expertise in data manipulation libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and PyTorch’s data utilities. Hands-on experience with audio processing libraries and tools (e.g., Librosa, FFmpeg, SoX) for handling complex audio formats. Familiarity with scalable pipeline tools like GitLab, Apache Spark, Airflow, or Luigi, and experience with containerized workflows (Docker, Kubernetes). Proven track record of managing dataset lifecycles and balancing dataset distributions to directly improve model accuracy, loss, and generalization in iterative research environments. Experience with immersive and multichannel audio formats. Knowledge of cloud-based platforms and tools for storage and processing, such as AWS S3, Redshift, or Google BigQuery. Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset for addressing evolving data challenges. Preferred Qualifications: Deep expertise in audio domain content, including specialized knowledge of dataset balancing techniques for complex, multi-speaker, or spatial audio environments. Familiarity with audio-specific datasets and metadata management strategies. Knowledge of machine learning principles and how data quality impacts model performance. Experience with distributed training pipelines and large-scale dataset processing. Contributions to open-source projects or published research in the fields of data science or audio processing. Experience with visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Matplotlib) for quality assurance and exploratory data analysis. Expertise in designing systems to support AI/ML model monitoring and retraining over time. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in San Francisco is $173,100 to $232,100. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. title: Senior DSP Engineer, ALG, Amazon Leo Government
description:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The mission of Amazon Leo Government (ALG) team is to leverage existing Kuiper technology and provide high speed, low latency, and secure satellite broadband services to the United States and our allied government customers.

The Senior DSP Engineer will play a pivotal role in the team delivering innovative and fast-paced analysis and design solutions, focusing on satellite and ground system design and analysis as well as on the design of the various phased array communication system needs (link budget, beamforming, calibration, compensation, etc.) of the electronics sub-systems. They will be expected to lead a variety of tasks, from DSP design and algorithm selection, to FPGA implementation and board bring-up and test. They will work across teams and support fellow engineers with design reviews and the preparation of joint reports and proposals. The candidate will have a sharp focus on the specific needs of the customer and be able to conduct trades and analyses to show that proposed solutions will meet the customer’s goals.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience working on complex programs with a diverse set of talented individuals, as well as with partner organizations (including government agencies). The candidate will exhibit the potential to lead small sub-teams of electrical engineers, and be able to prepare easy-to-read and technically compelling written reports.

CODE-10037

Key job responsibilities
- Interact directly with customers to understand technical requirements, and translate them into technically robust solutions backed by data and analysis.
- Design and develop DSP algorithms for phased array antenna communication systems including beamforming, beam steering, null steering, and adaptive array processing.
- Develop and validate signal processing chains in MATLAB and Simulink, including fixed-point modeling and bit-true simulations.
- Implement and optimize FFT/iFFT architectures for OFDM waveforms, channelization, spectral analysis, and frequency-domain beamforming.
- Collaborate with RF engineers, antenna engineers, and systems engineers to define interface requirements and performance budgets.
- Analyze system performance metrics (EVM, BER, SINR, beam patterns, sidelobe levels) and optimize DSP implementations.
- Develop calibration algorithms for phased array systems including amplitude/phase correction, mutual coupling compensation, and array manifold characterization.
- Model and simulate RF impairments (I/Q imbalance, phase noise, nonlinearity) and develop DSP-based mitigation techniques.
- Perform trade studies on algorithm complexity, latency, throughput, and resource utilization
- Deliver well-written documentation, reports, and presentations for technical design reviews and as part of proposal efforts.
- Design and support test campaigns, both development and qualification/acceptance, for space hardware.

Security Clearance: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

A day in the life
Basic qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent experience
7+ years of experience in hardware development across the full product life cycle (concept to production)
7+ years of electrical engineering work experience in Space, Aerospace/Defense, Automotive, and/or Communications fields or combination thereof.
7+ years of experience with DSP algorithm development and hardware test system debugging.

Preferred qualifications
- Master's or PhD degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or related discipline.
- Translate DSP algorithms from MATLAB/Simulink models to synthesizable HDL (VHDL/Verilog) using HDL Coder or manual RTL design.
- Architect efficient FPGA implementations of DSP processing chains with pipelining, parallelism, and resource sharing strategies
- Implement digital down-converters (DDC), digital up-converters (DUC), polyphase filter banks, and channelizers in Matlab / Simulink / RTL.
- Perform FPGA synthesis, timing closure, and resource optimization for Xilinx UltraScale+/Versal or Intel Agilex devices
- Verify RTL designs against MATLAB/Simulink golden reference models using co-simulation.
- Track record of successfully delivering compelling written reports and complete designs on time, to scope, with high quality.
- High sense of ownership, urgency, and drive; resourceful, and able to deliver results with minimal direction.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills.
- Demonstrated experience working with government agencies.
- US Security Clearance
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
Chief Financial Officer

Department: Finance & Operations

Reports to: CEO

Location: London area with hybrid working

Role Type: Full-time, permanent

About Us

At Cambridge Audio, we’re a different sort of global audio company, resolutely independent and always authentic.

We’re on a mission to break down barriers to top-tier sound, so it’s not the exception, but the norm. It’s what we’ve been doing for over 50 years, and we’re only just getting started.

Our award-winning product lineup includes headphones, lifestyle audio, and premium hi-fi. We also own StreamMagic, our own music streaming platform, plus a music venue and bar called Melomania at our London Bridge HQ.

Work at Cambridge Audio is more than just a job. We're passionate about what we do, and have fun doing it, developing our skills and careers, plus those of the colleagues around us. Learn more at https://cambridgeaudio.com/about-us

Our Culture

A shared love for music and a commitment to exceptional products and customer experience drive us. With strong team spirit across our five global offices, our core values define our work:

Made By Music - Inspired by shared passion and independence.

Pride in our product and service - Obsess over detail, always learning and improving.

Embrace the culture - Integrity, Innovation, Energy, Openness, Teamwork, Diversity, Flexibility, Fun, Music.

Make an impact - See it through. Go the extra mile.

About the Role

We're looking for a CFO to join our Senior Leadership Team, reporting to the CEO. This is a hands-on, commercial leadership role covering Finance, IT and systems, legal and risk, HR oversight and the internal running of the business.

We design premium audio products, have them manufactured in Asia, ship them worldwide, warehouse them and sell them through retailers, distributors, online marketplaces and our own e-commerce channel. That brings real financial complexity: inventory, landed costs, provisions, multi-entity reporting, VAT across channels and cash tied up in stock.

We need someone who already understands how a product business like ours works financially, and who will bring clarity, control and modern, joined-up systems as we grow.

Who This Role Is For

You've been a CFO or Finance Director in a business that designs, makes and sells physical products, or you're a senior finance leader in that kind of business who fully understands the role and is ready to step up

You know the pitfalls of product businesses: stock, provisioning, supply chain costs, multi-channel selling and cash flow

You want to build modern, efficient systems and processes, not maintain legacy ones

You don't need a background in consumer audio. Experience in a comparable product business, such as consumer goods, drinks or homewares, is just as relevant. This role is unlikely to suit candidates whose experience is mainly in service-based businesses such as professional services, software or telecoms.

What Great Looks Like

Accurate, timely reporting that budget holders actually use, with month-end accounts closed in days, not weeks

Clear visibility of margin and profitability by channel, customer and SKU

Cash flow actively managed, with strong controls and forward visibility

Joined-up systems, with our ERP (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central) used to its full potential

Well-documented, efficient processes across Finance, IT and HR

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Finance

Own the financial strategy, planning, forecasting and scenario modelling that support our growth plans

Act as a trusted, constructive challenger to the CEO and SLT on commercial decisions, pricing and investment

Lead treasury, banking relationships and capital structure

Partner with the Head of Procurement on inventory, landed cost, working capital and margin

Evaluate new business opportunities and strategic partnerships where relevant

2. Financial Control and Reporting

Oversee financial reporting across our UK, EU and Hong Kong entities

Maintain strong financial controls, compliance and audit readiness

Deliver clear, actionable management reporting to budget holders on a predictable cycle

Drive cost and margin improvement across the business, not just within Finance

Lead audits, board reporting and investor communications

3. Systems and IT

Own the systems and IT strategy, moving from disjointed tools to integrated, scalable systems

Get the most from Business Central and Power BI, automating reporting and finance processes

Oversee IT, working with our internal IT support and external technical advisers

Ensure technology governance and compliance, including GDPR and PCI DSS

Make sure every significant technology investment has a clear cost and business case before commitment

4. Operations, Legal and Risk

Oversee facilities, leases and the group insurance programme

Own legal, risk and company secretarial matters across the Group

5. People and Leadership

Provide oversight of HR, supported by our in-house HR lead and external HR advisers, ensuring people processes are professional and compliant

Lead and develop the finance team, building a well-documented, efficient function

Requirements

Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent)

Experience as a CFO or Finance Director, or senior finance leadership experience with a full understanding of what the role involves

Proven experience in a physical product business, ideally involving Far Eastern manufacturing, international distribution and multiple sales channels

Experience managing multi-entity, international reporting

Experience overseeing IT, systems and HR alongside Finance

Comfortable directing and holding external technical advisers to account, without needing to be a technologist yourself

Strong ERP experience, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or a comparable mid-market ERP

A track record of using automation, process improvement and technology to make finance faster and more efficient

Experienced in the use of and experimentation with AI as a copilot, also driving AI efficiencies within a team

Personal Profile

Dedicated to building a strong culture within your team, and the business

Commercially sharp, with a genuine interest in how a business like ours makes money and where it can improve

Ownership-driven - you take responsibility and follow through

Focused and disciplined, with a clear sense of your remit and how to deliver it well

Calm and constructive - comfortable challenging, always with respect

A self-driven learner who keeps up with new tools, software and ways of working

Equally comfortable with long-term strategy and day-to-day detail

Working Pattern & Duration

This is a full-time, permanent role.

Location

London area with hybrid working.

Compensation

Competitive salary based on experience.

Benefits

Health & Wellbeing

Subsidised private healthcare (50:50 contribution)

Annual wellness benefit pot covering 50% of life-enriching activities

Annual life-enhancement training allowance

24/7 GP and Mental Health assistance

Time & Flexibility

Charity volunteer days - 3 per year to support a cause of your choice

4pm finish on the last Friday of every month

Social & Culture

Regular socials organised by our “Director of Fun”

Annual team trips to surprise destinations

50% off gigs and festivals with our “Passion for Music” benefit

Recognition & Rewards

Profit share scheme

Colleague suggestion scheme to shape the way we work

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, let us know.

title: Systems Architect, End to End
description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

Bose Labs is building the technologies and platforms that will shape the future of Bose experiences. Within Bose Labs, SEA&P translates emerging technology into reusable architectures, platforms, and reference designs that can scale across Consumer and Automotive applications.

We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer – Systems Architect, E2E to define complete end-to-end systems spanning hardware, software, audio signal processing, acoustics, connectivity, sensing, compute, and user experience.

This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who thinks system-first . You will shape the overall architecture, go deep enough into individual domains to understand constraints and tradeoffs, and guide decisions across multiple engineering disciplines. Success requires broad technical depth, strong systems judgment, and the ability to earn credibility with specialists across hardware and software teams.

Who You Are

You are a systems thinker first . You start with the complete problem and intended experience, then determine how the hardware, software, and functional domains must work together to solve it.

You can operate at the highest level of architecture while going deep enough into individual domains to understand what is possible, where the risks are, and which tradeoffs matter most.

Most importantly, you want to help architect the future of Bose—turning advanced technology into coherent, scalable, differentiated systems that power exceptional Consumer and Automotive audio experiences .

What You’ll Do

Lead end-to-end system architecture for complex Consumer and Automotive audio systems.

Translate customer, product, and technology needs into coherent system architectures.

Define system decomposition, interfaces, data flows, functional boundaries, and resource allocation.

Drive tradeoffs across hardware, software, DSP, acoustics, connectivity, sensing, power, compute, performance, and cost.

Identify cross-domain risks and dependencies early and drive system-level solutions.

Use modeling, simulation, prototyping, and test data to evaluate architecture options.

Develop reusable architectures and reference solutions that scale across applications.

Provide Principal-level technical leadership across Bose Labs, engineering teams, suppliers, and technology partners.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Significant experience developing and architecting complex multidisciplinary systems.

Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end architecture across hardware and software .

Strong understanding of embedded systems, including interactions among hardware, software, firmware, signal processing, and physical constraints.

Experience defining system architectures, interfaces, functional decomposition, requirements, and technical tradeoffs.

Demonstrated ability to work across engineering disciplines and optimize the overall system.

Strong technical leadership and communication skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in Systems Engineering or a related technical discipline.

Experience architecting consumer audio, automotive audio, or other complex embedded systems .

Strong knowledge of digital audio signal processing, acoustics, and audio system architectures.

Experience with embedded processors, SoCs, DSPs, real-time operating systems, and Linux-based systems.

Background with distributed systems, connectivity, sensing, or hardware/software co-design.

Demonstrated experience developing reusable platforms, reference architectures, SDKs, frameworks, or technology building blocks.

Experience working with semiconductor vendors, suppliers, automotive partners, or third-party integrators.

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $168,300-$231,450.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.

In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

title: Phased Array DSP & Digital Beamforming Architect, Payload Architecture Team
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite constellation initiative designed to bring fast, affordable broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. We are building a next-generation satellite system from the ground up — designing everything from the spacecraft and payload to the ground infrastructure and customer terminals. This is a rare opportunity to join a team that is shaping the future of global connectivity at scale.

We are looking for a Phased Array DSP & Digital Beamforming Architect to join the Payload Architecture team in San Diego. This is a cross-program position that sits at the intersection of satellite system performance and phased array digital implementation — translating what the constellation needs to deliver into how the digital beamforming, signal processing, and data transport must be architected across both the Direct-to-Device (cellular-band) and Broadband (Ka-band) payloads. You will work closely with experienced architects and engineers across silicon, communication systems, and software disciplines, contributing to an architecture that must perform reliably from first power-on through years of unattended operation in low Earth orbit.

As the digital and DSP owner for the phased array, you will define how the antenna system achieves its performance targets from the digital side — establishing the architecture for digital beamforming, beam quality management, sidelobe control, null steering, beam scheduling, and multi-beam resource allocation. You will partner with silicon teams on chip architecture and performance targets, engage communication systems teams on waveform requirements and link performance, and work with software teams on beamforming algorithms and beam management. In addition to defining requirements for silicon, communication systems, and software teams, you will partner with each discipline through design, integration, and test — jointly resolving trade-offs and driving architecture outcomes measured in EIRP, G/T, and multi-beam efficiency.

The technical scope is broad and deep. You will own DPD and CFR architecture to preserve transmit signal quality across the full range of beam steering conditions and power levels. You will define fronthaul architecture and high-speed SerDes backend design, establishing how payload data is transported and distributed across digital subsystems. Backend throughput management — ensuring the digital backbone handles aggregate traffic load across all active beams — is a core responsibility, as is capacity allocation across beams and digital domains. You will architect redundancy and graceful degradation strategies so that digital processing and transport paths continue delivering service when individual components fail — because in-orbit hardware cannot be repaired.

The space environment shapes every decision in this role. Radiation effects on digital processing platforms require purpose-built mitigation strategies that preserve both performance and reliability across the satellite’s operational life. Thermal and power constraints are first-order inputs to architecture choices, not afterthoughts. You will work with the verification team to validate the phased array digital architecture through test, and you will collaborate across silicon, communication systems, software, systems, hardware design, antenna, calibration, thermal, power, mechanical, and reliability teams to drive the architecture from early concept through production and on-orbit performance. Beyond the current programs, you will evaluate emerging digital beamforming techniques and next-generation processing platforms to shape the architecture roadmap for future satellite generations.

This is a hands-on role — you will be in the lab, in the data, and on call when satellites are live. If you have experience in phased array DSP architecture and digital beamforming, we want to hear from you.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the phased array digital and DSP architecture across both D2D and Broadband payloads — spanning digital beamforming, signal processing, and data transport
• Translate satellite system performance targets into phased array digital architecture decisions across the beamforming stack — including EIRP, G/T, multi-beam efficiency, and signal quality
• Partner with silicon teams on beamformer chip architecture, interface definitions, and performance targets through design, integration, and characterization
• Partner with communication systems teams on waveform requirements, link performance, and digital processing trade-offs to support end-to-end capacity goals
• Partner with software teams on beamforming algorithm architecture including beam scheduling, null steering, and adaptive beamforming through to validated hardware performance
• Drive phased array beam quality, sidelobe performance, and multi-beam efficiency through digital architecture decisions across all operating conditions
• Architect DPD and CFR to maintain transmit signal quality across beam steering angles, power levels, and thermal conditions
• Define fronthaul architecture and high-speed SerDes backend for payload data transport and distribution across digital subsystems
• Architect backend throughput management and capacity allocation across beams and digital subsystems
• Define redundancy and graceful degradation strategies for digital processing and transport paths
• Define radiation mitigation approach for digital processing platforms
• Evaluate emerging technologies for future architecture roadmap, and support production and on-orbit performance — hands-on, on-call

A day in the life
A typical day involves a mix of architecture work, cross-discipline collaboration, and hands-on analysis. You might spend the morning reviewing digital beamforming architecture trade-offs with the silicon team, then move to a session with communication systems engineers working through link performance and waveform requirements. Afternoons often involve DPD or backend throughput analysis, reviewing signal quality data from integration testing, or working through a redundancy architecture trade study. Lab time is part of the rhythm — characterizing beamforming performance, validating signal quality through the digital chain, or supporting phased array integration. When a satellite is live, you are available. Some weeks are heavier on roadmap work and emerging technology evaluation; others are dominated by resolving a specific performance challenge in the current program.

About the team
The Payload Architecture team is part of the Antenna organization at Amazon Leo. We are a small group of senior architects responsible for the phased array architecture across Amazon Leo’s satellite programs. We define the architecture, drive requirements, run trade studies, and make sure everything works from prototype through orbit. Our scope extends to customer link performance — working with systems and customer terminal teams to close end-to-end link budgets. We work closely with every engineering team on the payload and pride ourselves on being hands-on problem solvers.

- 7+ years of digital design in communication systems experience
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in embedded wireless systems
- Experience in developing link and system level simulators using MATLAB, Python, or C++
- Experience with RF measurement equipment, including: power meters, spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators, network analyzers, oscilloscopes

At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. ABOUT THE CO-OP PROGRAM

Bose Corporation is seeking students to participate in our Co-op Program who share our belief that sound is power. During the six-month co-op, students will have the chance to apply classroom learning in a hands-on work environment. Co-op participants will network across the business to gain diverse perspectives within Bose Corporation. Being currently authorized to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment for this position .

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Co-op to join our research team and explore how AI agents can support engineers working on active sound management technologies.

The role sits at the boundary between signal processing and software engineering. You don't need to be an active noise control expert on day one; you will learn the domain from senior engineers who build these tools. You should be a strong programmer who is comfortable reading engineering code and asking why it works.

In this role, you will:

Capture expert knowledge. Work with senior engineers to document engineering workflows: key decisions, heuristics, failure modes, and what a finished result looks like.

Modernize engineering tools. Refactor existing tools into modular functions with well-defined inputs and outputs.

Connect tools to AI agents. Make engineering functions available to LLM-based agents using Python and modern tool-calling interfaces.

Measure what works. Build an evaluation framework that compares agent results against expert-produced references.

Build in safeguards. Implement automated checks that keep agent outputs within engineering and safety limits.

Prototype and demonstrate. Build an agent-assisted workflow and demonstrate it on a real engineering use case.

Report and document. Present your results and document your work so the team can build on it after your term.

To excel in this role, candidates should possess the following:

Currently pursuing a PhD or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

Strong Python: writing modular code, packaging functions, using git, and writing tests

Working knowledge of MATLAB, enough to read and refactor existing engineering scripts

Signal processing fundamentals: FFT, spectra, transfer functions, coherence, and digital filters

Hands-on experience calling an LLM API or building a simple agent or tool-using app, in a project, course, or internship

Clear written communication; the role involves documenting expert knowledge, not just code

Preferred Qualifications:

Coursework or projects in adaptive filtering, active noise control, or acoustics

Background in optimal filtering, multichannel systems, or control systems

Familiarity with Simulink

Experience with LLM agent frameworks, tool calling, or agent protocols such as MCP

Experience designing evaluations or test suites for ML or LLM systems

Experience integrating MATLAB and Python

Comfort with large measurement datasets (time series, .mat or HDF5 files) and with plotting results clearly

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

How active noise cancellation systems are measured, designed, and optimized

How to turn expert engineering judgment into reliable, testable software

How to build and evaluate an LLM agent for a real engineering task where reliability matters

Your responsibilities will include: Mastering the system end-to-end, from DSP logic on a loudspeaker to higher-level cluster services. Leading exploratory testing sessions, documenting edge cases as manual test suites, and resolving issues directly. Developing and maintaining features of the embedded platform and the surrounding services. Converting manual tests into automated suites running continuously against physical or simulated hardware. Deep Linux knowledge: boot path, systemd, filesystems, networking, kernel interfaces. Experience with test instrumentation hardware: switched PDUs, serial consoles, relay boards, audio capture. Experience with digital audio or Audio-over-IP: Dante, RAVENNA/AES67, PTP, ST 2022-7. Experience with networking: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6. We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching About us HOLOPLOT is a pro audio company from Berlin, Germany. Since early 2011, we have been working on radically transforming audio technology, by re-thinking the underlying physics of sound reproduction. We wondered: What if sound could truly be controlled the way we can control light? What if we could create soundscapes that feel more real than reality? What if every seat in a venue could be made the best seat? Our solution is science-based, software-driven, and hardware-enabled: the HOLOPLOT Matrix Array. The sound system for a new era, a powerful tool that brings previously inaccessible capabilities to the world of audio. We believe when people experience better sound, they will enjoy more meaningful moments and create richer memories. At HOLOPLOT, it is our mission to redefine what is possible - enabling unparalleled and breathtaking experiences. A revolution in sound. Be part of it. Apply for this job

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

The Role

As a Senior BDR, you own the top of the funnel for our new business motion. You'll research and break into strategic accounts, run creative multi-channel outbound to engineering and product leaders, and generate the qualified pipeline our Account Executives close. Because our buyers are technical, this isn't spray-and-pray — you'll speak credibly about APIs, model accuracy, and where we beat the alternatives, and you'll earn meetings on substance.
This is a senior individual-contributor role. You'll take our hardest, highest-value accounts, operate with real autonomy, and help build the outbound playbook from the ground up as one of the first people in the seat.

What You'll Do

Own outbound pipeline generation into a defined set of strategic accounts

Break into accounts with sharp, personalized, multi-channel outreach — email, phone, social, and video — grounded in real account research, not templates

Engage technical decision-makers (CTOs, VPs of Engineering, product leaders) and articulate why AssemblyAI wins on performance and developer experience

Qualify opportunities and run clean, high-context handoffs to Account Executives

Represent AssemblyAI at events and in the developer and voice AI communities

Partner with Marketing and Sales on messaging, sequences, and account targeting — and feed what's working (and what isn't) back into the motion

Help build the outbound playbook from the ground up, testing new channels and sequences as we scale

What You'll Need

1-3+ years in a BDR/SDR role, with a proven track record of generating qualified pipeline from cold outreach

Comfort learning and speaking to technical concepts: APIs, model accuracy and latency tradeoffs, and competitive differentiation

Genuine creativity and persistence in outbound — you find a way in when the obvious channels don't work

Self-direction: you thrive with ownership and little process, and you set your own high bar

Strong CRM and prospecting-tool fluency (Salesforce, and tools like Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)

Experience selling technical products — API, infrastructure, developer tools, or AI/ML — to technical buyers is a plus

While AssemblyAI is a remote-first company, this role is expected to be based in New York, full-time in the office and meeting with prospective customers in person.

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer.

Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range.

$100,000–$140,000 OTE (On-Target Earnings)

The range provided applies to candidates located in the United States . For candidates outside of the U.S., compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process.

Salary range:

The expected total compensation for this role is listed above (including base salary and commission). Our total compensation package includes competitive equity grants, 100% employer-paid benefits, and working alongside the team in our New York City office. A 401k match up to 4% is offered to all US-based full time team members.

Using AI in your interview
If you’re selected for an interview, please read our Candidate AI Guidance . It explains how you can use AI at each stage of our process, from your application and take-home to the interviews themselves.

GDPR privacy notice
If you’re applying from the EU or UK, please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice before applying.

title: Electrical Engineer

Create test plans for verifying the designs.

Integrating multiple printed circuit board assemblies into a product, including the mechanical assembly/disassembly of the enclosure/chassis.

Performing functional testing under a variety of conditions (e.g., thermal).

Accompanying equipment to and from labs for EMI testing.

Performing soldering/rework on PCBAs as needed.

Participate in project meetings.

Preparing and submitting status reports.

Other duties as assigned by your manager or project lead.

An eagerness to learn.

A Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering.

3-5 years of experience in a design engineering role, ideally with a strong background in microcontroller-based systems involving audio.

Knowledge about audio electronics and/or the industry.

Basic knowledge of EMI/EMC requirements and design/mitigation techniques.

Knowledge of common communication protocols (e.g., serial, I2C, SPI).

Solid understanding of the use of common test tools (e.g., oscilloscope, logic analyzer, spectrum analyzer).

title: Industrialization Architect
description:
Would you like to shape how the next generation of hearing aids moves from product development into robust, scalable production?

As an Industrialization Architect in New Product Introduction (NPI) , you will leverage your technical expertise to define operational requirements and develop the system architecture and designs needed to industrialize new products. Working closely with R&D, NPI, and Operations, you will ensure that new product designs can be efficiently manufactured, tested, verified, and successfully transferred into production.

As part of our SAFe setup, you will provide technical leadership across teams and help establish the architectural foundation needed for successful product industrialization.

What tasks are waiting for you:
• Translate R&D architecture into measurable requirements for manufacturing, assembly, programming, calibration, test and traceability – with clear acceptance criteria and requirement-to-verification traceability.
• Define the production verification and test strategy, and assess technical readiness for each engineering and pre-production build.
• Develop system architectures and solution designs that guide development teams and ensure alignment with operational needs.
• Review designs and critical interfaces (PCB, mechanics, electro-acoustics, battery, antennas, HW/FW, production equipment) from a DFM/DFA/DFT perspective, and drive trade-offs with R&D.
• Provide technical leadership during engineering and pre-production builds, supporting root-cause investigations and resolution of complex technical issues.
• Assess engineering changes and shape the architectural runway (fixtures, test platforms, process steps) in SAFe PI Planning.

What you bring:
• MSc in Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical or Systems Engineering, or a related field.
• Solid experience as an architect, technical lead or similar within Operations or Product Development, preferably in medtech, electronics, or other regulated industries (hearing aid experience is an advantage), where complex electronic products are taken from prototype through pilot builds to a high-mix and high-volume manufacturing environment.
• Knowledge of several of: low-power and miniaturized electronics, PCB/PCA, power and batteries, RF/antennas, electro-acoustics, mechanical-electrical interfaces, manufacturing process automation.
• Hands-on DFM/DFA/DFT experience, tolerance analysis, process capability, production test and calibration concepts.
• Practical requirements engineering and verification experience, plus structured problem solving.
• Ability to lead across R&D, NPI and Operations without formal authority, and fluent English.
Nice to have: hearing-aid, hearable or medical-device experience (design controls, ISO 13485) and SAFe.

Working with us, you will:
• have real influence on how new hearing aids are designed for production – from concept review to volume manufacturing;
• combine architecture work with hands-on engineering on the pre-production floor;
• be part of a Scandinavian work culture built on trust, independence and open dialogue.

title: Senior Analog Design Engineer
description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, which was built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!

We are seeking a highly motivated Analog Design Engineer to join a collaborative hardware design team developing high performance analog and mixed signal integrated circuits for advanced consumer and embedded applications. In this role, you will contribute to the design of next generation ICs spanning data converters, power management, amplifiers, and common analog infrastructure implemented in advanced CMOS processes.

You will participate in the full IC development lifecycle, from concept and architecture through silicon validation and production, while working closely with cross functional teams to deliver robust, manufacturable solutions that integrate easily into customer systems.

Responsibilities:

Design and develop analog and mixed-signal IC blocks from concept through production, including data converters, power management, amplifiers, and supporting circuitry in advanced CMOS processes.

Define architectures, perform transistor‑level design, and create behavioral and system models using tools such as Matlab, Verilog‑A, SystemVerilog, and Simulink.

Simulate and verify circuit and chip‑level performance using Spectre and mixed‑signal methodologies (analog‑on‑top, digital‑on‑top).

Lead or support layout implementation, post‑layout simulation, and performance optimization, ensuring DRC/LVS closure.

Perform silicon bring‑up, lab validation, debug, and post‑silicon characterization using standard lab instrumentation.

Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including digital, layout, test, and systems engineering to ensure robust, manufacturable designs.

Support product validation, characterization, and production test development through debug, analysis, and silicon learning.

Contribute to design reviews, technical documentation, and reusable analog infrastructure or platforms.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field:

Bachelor’s with 5+ years of relevant IC design experience.

Master’s with 3+ years of relevant IC design experience.

PhD with 0+ years of relevant IC design experience.

Strong foundation in CMOS analog and mixed‑signal IC design.

Deep understanding of the analog design flow: architecture, design, integration, verification, and silicon validation.

Proficiency with analog modeling and simulation tools (e.g., Matlab, Spectre, Verilog‑A, SystemVerilog).

Solid understanding of device physics, noise analysis, stability, and control theory.

Hands‑on lab experience with silicon debug and validation.

Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.

Organized, detail‑oriented, and comfortable working in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

Experience with:

Power conversion architectures (inductive and/or capacitive)

Delta‑sigma ADCs/DACs and discrete‑time or continuous‑time signal processing

Switched‑capacitor circuits, PLLs, LNAs, and audio‑oriented analog blocks

System and behavioral modeling

Familiarity with reliability topics (ESD, latch‑up, long‑term device stress).

Experience across multiple CMOS process nodes and geometry scales.

Ability to plan, lead, and review analog subsystem designs.

title: Digital Design Engineer
description:
**Summary Description****:**

Syntiant Corp., is a leader in the high-growth AI software and semiconductor solutions space. We are seeking a lead **Digital Design Engineer** who will be designing the digital systems and building blocks for MEMS microphones. Together with the analog/mixed-signal designers, test development engineers and other team members, you will be developing high-performance, low-power ASICs from concept to high-volume production.

## Requirements

**Specific Duties and Responsibilities****:**

- Develop the digital architecture including audio signal path (DSP) and analog-digital interface with the project team.
- Build complex functional and behavioral models of the systems using Matlab/Simulink, Verilog-AMS, etc.
- Perform RTL design, synthesis, timing closure, scan pattern generation, power optimization and supervise the RTL-to-GDS flow.
- Define the digital verification plan.
- Verify the digital system and blocks in collaboration with the digital verification engineer.
- Develop low-power audio signal processing architectures.

**Qualifications, Education, and Experience Required:**

- Advanced Degree in electronic engineering or related field.
- 8+ years of proven track record in developing digital blocks/systems for high-performance mixed-signal integrated circuits in a consumer or industrial R&D environment.
- Good understanding of the entire digital design flow and DFT.
- Experience with Digital Signal Processing (DSP) implementations
- Hands-on experience in designing low-power digital circuits.
- Good understanding of most common concepts and metrics used in analog/mixed signal design (Sampling, Quantization, FFT, SNR, THD, etc.)
- Experience with sigma delta ADCs or audio signal processing.
- Understanding of the most common limitations and issues of analog circuits (offset, gain error, distortion, etc.) is an advantage.
- Knowledge in EDA tools such as Cadence Digital EDA suite (Genus, Tempus, Jasper, Voltus, Modus, Conformal etc.) is an advantage.
- Solid knowledge of Matlab/Simulink environment.
- Structured and methodological approach.
- Strong team player.
- Good spoken and written communication skills in English.

## Benefits

**Benefits Summary:**

- **Medical:** Several plan options including PPO and HSA-compatible plans from Anthem Blue Cross, most of which are 100% paid by Syntiant Corp. for you and your family.
- **Dental:** Company-paid dental PPO coverage from MetLife, including coverage for Orthodontia.
- **Vision:** Company-paid vision PPO coverage from MetLife / VSP.
- **Life Insurance / AD&D:** Company-paid basic Life / AD&D coverage in the amount of 3x your salary (up to $1,000,000). Additional supplemental life insurance with low group rates is available for yourself and your family.
- **Disability Coverage:** Company-paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability coverage provides up to 60% income replacement protection.
- **Spending and Savings Accounts:** Flexible Spending Account (FSA) benefits for Health Care and Dependent Care. Health Savings Accounts (HSA) for those enrolled in a qualified Medical plan.
- **401K Retirement Plan:** Administered by Empower, the 401(k) plan allows you to plan for your future by investing a portion of each paycheck.
- **Other Benefits:** A company-provided Employee Assistance Program (EAP), as well as access to additional voluntary benefits including Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Support, and Identity Fraud Protection.

**About Syntiant:**

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Irvine, Calif., Syntiant Corp. is a leader in delivering hardware and software solutions for edge AI deployment. The company’s purpose-built silicon and hardware-agnostic models are being deployed globally to power edge AI speech, audio, sensor and vision applications across a wide range of consumer and industrial use cases, from earbuds to automobiles. Syntiant’s advanced chip solutions merge deep learning with semiconductor design to produce ultra-low-power, high performance, deep neural network processors. Syntiant also provides compute-efficient software solutions with proprietary model architectures that enable world-leading inference speed and minimized memory footprint across a broad range of processors. The company is backed by several of the world’s leading strategic and financial investors including Intel Capital, Microsoft’s M12, Applied Ventures, Bosch Ventures, the Amazon Alexa Fund, and Atlantic Bridge Capital. More information on the company can be found by visiting [www.syntiant.com](http://www.syntiant.com/).

One element in our total compensation package is base pay. The starting base pay for this role is targeted to be between $190,000 - $240,000. Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including but not limited to previous experience and skills acquired prior to joining Syntiant, cost of living in the assigned work location, assigned schedule, and salaries of similarly situated peers at the company. It is to be expected that candidates will come to us with different sets of skills and experiences and therefore will be paid at different points in the stated range. We recognize that the person(s) we select for hire may be less experienced or more experienced than the role as posted; if this is the case, any updates to available salary ranges will be communicated with candidates during the recruitment process.

title: Audio AI Research Scientist — Audio Source Separation
description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

Research Scientist — Audio Source Separation

Description

The goal of our team is to develop novel AI-powered audio processing algorithms. The twist is that our algorithms must run in real time, on physical devices, for applications such as dynamic awareness, hearing augmentation, agentic perception, voice pickup, content enhancement, and ones we haven’t even thought of yet. You will work with experts in ML, DSP, software engineering, and psychoacoustics to prototype and implement new algorithms.

You will develop next-generation algorithms that isolate, extract, or suppress individual sound sources from microphone recordings, sometimes augmented by other sensor signals. Applications include voice pickup, hearing augmentation, and new audio experiences that must ultimately run in real time on physical devices.

Bose has a strong history of combining creative thinking with cutting-edge audio technology. We are looking for people passionate about machine learning and audio to help shape what comes next.

Responsibilities

· Research, prototype, train, and evaluate novel source separation and extraction algorithms for speech and other real-world sounds.

· Develop approaches for single- and multi-microphone recordings, including spatial cues and optional auxiliary sensors.

· Investigate robust separation in challenging conditions such as overlapping talkers, noise, reverberation, and motion.

· Evaluate perceptual quality, separation performance, generalization, latency, memory, and computational requirements.

· Collaborate with DSP and embedded software teams to deploy models in real-time demonstrations and product platforms; contribute to patents and conference papers.

Education

Graduate degree (MS or PhD) in machine learning, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

Skills

· Deep hands-on experience in audio source separation, target sound extraction, speech enhancement, or related neural audio processing.

· Comfortable tackling complex, open-ended problems where you have to experiment with and discard many ideas before finding the right solution.

· Strong knowledge of audio DSP, time-frequency methods, and microphone array or spatial signal processing.

· Experience training and evaluating audio models in PyTorch; proficiency in Python and familiarity with C/C++ is a plus.

· Understanding of objective and perceptual evaluation methods and the tradeoffs involved in real-time low-power inference.

· Experience with multimodal or sensor-conditioned separation, ONNX/TFLite, or embedded deployment is a plus.

· Strong communication skills; publications at conferences such as ICASSP, Interspeech, NeurIPS, or similar are welcome but not required.

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $165,400-$227,500.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.

In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.
