title: Digital Operations Team Lead - Music Rights & Royalties
description:
What you will be doing

As an Operations Team Lead, you will play a central role in guiding and empowering the Digital Operations team to deliver on its objectives. Reporting to the Head of Digital Operations and acting as their deputy, you will lead the team’s day-to-day work and oversee execution across core DSP processing and reporting pipelines, ensuring high-quality data exchange, timely royalty allocations, and strict compliance with client Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Your contributions will directly shape how the team runs and how we deliver DSP Processing and Reporting for our clients , making you an integral part of our team.

### Key Responsibilities

- Execute the workflows and priorities set with the Head of Digital Operations, collaborating with Business Line, Engineering, and the wider Operations team, including operational support and communication with all of our DSP Processing and Reporting clients.
- Act as deputy to the Head of Digital Operations, covering for them when needed and making operational decisions on behalf of the team. Serve as the primary escalation point for the Operations Specialist team, triaging complex queries related to catalog ingest, matching exceptions, and output generation.
- Manage agreed business priorities, task allocations, and daily operational workflows for the Digital Operations Specialist team.
- Coordinate end-to-end DSP processing cycles across major platforms (including YouTube, Spotify, Amazon, and SoundCloud).
- Oversee the organization and maintenance of strict delivery schedules.
- Mentor and train team members, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and continuous learning environment.
- Manage pre-distribution calculations, conflict resolution lifecycles, and claiming output generation

### Collaboration and Team Dynamics

You will work closely with the Head of Digital Operations to plan priorities, track team performance, and continuously improve how we operate. You will also collaborate with Business Line, Engineering, Product, and Partnership teams to optimize system reliability and operational scale. These collaborations are pivotal for achieving our organizational goals and ensuring effective communication and alignment across different areas of the company.

## Requirements

All about you

- Preferably 5+ years of experience in Music Industry Operations.
- Experience in managing a team or related roles is preferred but not mandatory.
- Demonstrate understanding of music copyrights principles, practices, and relevant regulations.
- Deep familiarity with music metadata standards, Common Works Registration (CWR), DDEX Digital Sales Reports (DSRs), etc.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical and operational requirements clearly across diverse global teams.
- Ability to effectively communicate with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.
- Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
- Demonstrate strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to analyze large volumes of usage data, diagnose root causes of operational discrepancies, and design efficient process solutions.
- Proficiency working with complex data platforms (YouTube CMS/Content ID), Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets, SQL querying, and SFTP data exchange protocol.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
- Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
- Demonstrate adaptability and openness to feedback and learning opportunities.
- Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and high-stakes client deadlines.
- Fluency in English. Proficiency in Spanish and Catalan is highly appreciated, but not mandatory.
- The role is located in Barcelona. Local candidates are preferred, but remote work arrangements may be considered.

### **Expectations of the role**

Within 30 Days:

During the first month, your primary focus will be on familiarizing yourself with essential aspects of the role and supporting foundational tasks.

- Familiarize yourself thoroughly with BMAT’s core operating platforms and DSP processing lifecycle standards.
- Align with the Head of Digital Operations on team priorities, ways of working, and responsibilities.
- Establish working relationships with direct reports and key cross-functional partners across Engineering, Product, and Partnerships.
- Assume day-to-day oversight of operational queues and SLA tracking for core processing clients

Within 60 Days:

By the second month, you'll be expected to take on more complex responsibilities and actively contribute to team and strategic initiatives.

- Autonomously manage daily task distribution, priority queues, and technical escalations for the Digital Operations team.
- Lead high-priority client distribution cycles, ensuring 100% on-time delivery of claim files, pre-distribution reports, and DIF files.
- Partner with Product and Engineering to implement automated matching QA rules and streamline conflict resolution tracking.
- Facilitate the transition of routine client invoicing workflows from Partnerships to Operations in collaboration with Finance.

Within 90 Days:

At the end of the probationary period, you'll be expected to autonomously manage tasks, contribute to strategic planning, and take on leadership roles as appropriate.

- Autonomously manage team operations, performance evaluations, continuous training, and skill development.
- Drive measurable improvements in operational throughput, team capacity, and SLA compliance across all Tier 1 and Tier 2 DSP accounts.
- Represent Digital Operations in cross-departmental readiness reviews and platform feature validations.

## Benefits

### You Can Enjoy

- Flexible working hours and location
- Flat hierarchy
- You can make the role your own and run your own development
- Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English
- Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
- We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
- Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest.
- Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room [https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/](https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/)

###

### Who the FAQ are BMAT

BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 250 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, New Jersey, Oslo, LA, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.

We’re [a team of pretty decent people](http://www.bmat.com/team) who enjoy working with each other. We’re open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music and the excitement for innovative technology have proven to make a good combination.

BMAT has grown as a company of companies. Within BMAT there are a number of products and services that developed semi autonomously for different players – Digital Service Providers, Publishers and Collective Management Organisations.

_Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work._

title: Software Engineer II & Senior Software Engineer - (CoreAI Speech, Translation, and Data Platforms)
Advanced Development Audio Experience Engineer
description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

The Role

Bose Labs is seeking a creative, curious, and hands-on Senior Audio Systems Engineer to help create the next generation of audio experiences for consumer technologies.

In this role, you will explore new use cases, develop experience concepts, and create reusable audio technology platforms and system architectures that accelerate the integration and deployment of emerging Bose technologies in both Bose products and third-party experiences. You will work across acoustics, electroacoustics, digital signal processing, psychoacoustics, transducers, and system engineering to advance ideas from early exploration through technical validation and into product- or partner-development programs.

You will collaborate with researchers, engineers, product teams, and business leaders across Bose to identify opportunities, assess technical feasibility, define system architectures, and mature promising technologies for adoption through Bose consumer technology platforms.

This position sits at the intersection of research and product development. The successful candidate will be passionate about audio and music, comfortable working in ambiguous problem spaces, and able to combine rigorous engineering with strong perceptual judgment and creative experimentation.

Responsibilities

Explore consumer needs, use cases, and experience opportunities, translating these insights into experience concepts, technical requirements, experiments, and evaluation plans.

Define reusable audio-system architectures, interfaces, and integration approaches that enable emerging technologies to be applied efficiently across products, form factors, and partner applications.

Design, tune, and evaluate prototypes and reference implementations across a range of consumer form factors, including personal, wearable, portable, embedded, and out-loud audio devices.

Develop and evaluate signal-processing approaches that improve audio performance or enable new consumer experiences.

Conduct acoustic and electroacoustic measurements of components, subsystems, and complete systems, combining objective data with critical listening and perceptual evaluation to guide technical improvements.

Collaborate with engineers and researchers across DSP, controls, acoustics, electrical, mechanical, and software disciplines to optimize system performance.

Define and evaluate requirements for audio components such as loudspeakers, micro-speakers, microphones, and related acoustic structures.

Identify important system-level tradeoffs, risks, constraints, and opportunities early in development, and use experimentation to guide technical decisions.

Present concepts, experimental results, recommendations, and technical risks through peer reviews, design reviews, written documentation, and stakeholder demonstrations.

Provide technical leadership within cross-functional teams by framing ambiguous problems, guiding system-level tradeoffs, and establishing clear technical direction.

Collaborate with Bose product, platform, and business-unit teams—and with external partners as appropriate—to mature promising concepts and support their transition into Bose products and third-party experiences.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Acoustical Engineering, Audio Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Ten or more years of relevant professional experience in audio system development, acoustical engineering, digital signal processing, or consumer audio.

Strong foundation in digital signal processing, signals and systems, acoustics, electroacoustics, psychoacoustics, and transducer fundamentals.

Demonstrated experience defining audio-system architectures and balancing requirements across acoustics, signal processing, transducers, electronics, software, and mechanical constraints.

Hands-on experience designing, integrating, measuring, tuning, and troubleshooting high-performance audio systems.

Proficiency with MATLAB or an equivalent environment for measurement, data analysis, signal processing, or algorithm development.

Strong critical-listening skills and an ability to connect perceptual observations with objective system behavior.

Experience making technical decisions in situations where requirements, architectures, or development paths are not yet fully defined.

Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to engineering specialists, business stakeholders, and audiences outside the immediate technical discipline.

Demonstrated ability to lead technical work across disciplines and collaborate effectively with researchers, engineers, product teams, and business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing consumer audio products or advanced prototypes involving headphones, earbuds, wearables, portable speakers, home audio, embedded audio, or other consumer devices.

Experience with active noise cancellation, noise management, voice pickup, speech processing, beamforming, acoustic echo cancellation, voice activity detection, or related microphone-system technologies.

Familiarity with loudspeaker and microphone design, lumped-parameter models, micro-drivers, ECM microphones, MEMS microphones, enclosure design, and acoustic porting.

Experience using acoustic test and measurement systems from suppliers such as Brüel & Kjær, GRAS, Audio Precision, National Instruments, Listen/SoundCheck, or equivalent platforms.

Experience implementing, integrating, or tuning algorithms on real-time DSP, embedded, or rapid-prototyping platforms.

Experience transferring technology from an advanced-development or research environment into a product-development program.

Experience collaborating with external technology partners or integrating audio technologies into third-party products and platforms.

A background in music performance, recording, mixing, sound design, or another discipline that has developed highly trained listening skills.

Working at Bose Labs

This position spans multiple programs and technology areas. Projects may range from short explorations intended to answer a focused technical or experiential question to longer efforts that produce integrated, experience-ready demonstrations.

This role requires comfort moving between detailed engineering work and broader experience discussions. At different points, you may be measuring a prototype in the lab, tuning signal processing, conducting a listening evaluation, defining a system architecture, presenting a demonstration, or helping a Bose product, platform or partner team understand how a technology could be incorporated into a future consumer offering.

Occasional domestic or international travel may be required to support collaborations, demonstrations, partner engagements, or development activities.

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. title: Principal Wireless Protocol Architect/Engineer
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Principal Wireless Protocol Architect/Engineer

We are building a small team of versatile and enthusiastic leaders to create new products for the PlayStation community. Our team recently delivered the new PlayStation Link, PULSE Explore and PULSE Elite products, recently announced the FlexStrike and PULSE Elevate products, and are hard at work on what comes next. We need an experienced and innovative firmware engineer to help build and support our new products and features.

In this role, you will be the technical point of accountability for wireless across accessories: hardware, platform software, audio, security, and product all will route protocol questions to you. You will represent the protocol and the implementation to silicon and ODM partners, evaluate combo-SoC roadmaps, drive vendor firmware defects to resolution, and design so that a supplier change is a port, not a rewrite.

You will write the technical strategy documents that let a Director and a VP make an informed decision. And, grow the technical depth by being the leader that mentors senior engineers toward staff and principal, and raise the design-review bar for the whole org.

Come and play with us!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead firmware development for high profile product development efforts. You will be responsible for technical leadership, system architecture, and execution across the firmware domain, working closely with internal teams and external partners.

Own firmware architecture and design for transport, wireless protocol, firmware and software stacks for embedded devices from concept through production

Develop and define communication protocols to enable peripheral functionality

Design, implement, and scale low-latency RF/wireless communication protocols for embedded systems

Architect structured, modular, and reusable firmware frameworks that scale across multiple platforms and product lines

Lead and mentor firmware engineers (internal and external partners)

Ensure firmware designs support cross-platform reuse and long-term scalability

Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across hardware, firmware, and RF domains

Skills

Strong in firmware and software architectural patterns

Strong embedded firmware development experience in C/C++

Industry authority level experience with RF/wireless systems (e.g., Bluetooth, low-latency audio, or similar technologies)

Deep understanding of low-latency embedded systems and communication protocol design

Proven ability to design scalable, reusable, and cross-platform firmware architectures

Experience with ARM microcontrollers and low-power system design

Hands-on experience with hardware bring-up and debugging (including RF/system-level issues)

Experience implementing hardware-in-the-loop and automated testing

Strong system-level thinking across hardware and software boundaries

As a Digital Design Engineer, you will be part of a collaborative, cross‑functional team developing high‑performance mixed‑signal integrated circuits used by leading consumer, industrial, audio, power, and embedded system manufacturers. In this role, you will contribute to the design of system‑on‑chip (SoC) devices, digital signal processing blocks, and digital control logic that interface with high‑performance ADCs, DACs, amplifiers, and power management circuitry, implemented in advanced CMOS technologies. You will play a key role in bringing digital subsystems from concept to production silicon, working closely with analog, verification, layout, and test teams to deliver robust, manufacturable designs.

Responsibilities:

Design and implement digital subsystems and IP blocks for mixed‑signal ICs from architecture through tape‑out.

Develop RTL designs using Verilog and support integration into larger SoC environments.

Design and verify DSP, control, and data‑path logic, including calibration and monitoring state machines.

Perform functional verification, integration verification, and support UVM‑based verification teams.

Contribute to behavioral and system modeling of digital and mixed‑signal systems

Support post‑silicon validation, characterization, and production test, including lab bring‑up and silicon debug.

Collaborate across disciplines to ensure correct interaction between digital logic and analog circuitry.

Participate in design reviews, tape‑out readiness, and root‑cause analysis for silicon or system issues.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

Bachelor’s with 2+ years of relevant digital IC design experience.

Master’s with 0+ years of relevant experience.

Strong working knowledge of Verilog RTL design.

Solid understanding of the digital design flow, including:

Microarchitecture and RTL development.

Clock and reset domain crossing.

Functional verification.

Timing constraints and synthesis.

Experience designing and verifying complex state machines and control logic.

Familiarity with CMOS VLSI design fundamentals.

Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.

Ability to work effectively in a team‑based, fast‑paced development environment.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

Expertise or strong background in Digital Signal Processing (DSP).

Experience implementing FIR and IIR filters and other signal‑processing algorithms.

Familiarity with ARM‑based SoCs, microprocessor subsystems, buses, and peripherals.

Experience with mixed‑signal IC development, including interaction between digital and analog circuitry.

Exposure to low‑power and high‑performance ASIC design techniques.

Experience with back‑end flows, including synthesis, place & route, and timing analysis.

Experience generating test vectors and supporting production or probe test environments.

Proficiency with MATLAB, Simulink, or similar tools for modeling, algorithm development, and validation.

Strong lab and silicon validation skills, including silicon debug and characterization.

description:

JOB DESCRIPTION AND POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Project: Voices, Outlooks, and Information Networks in Civic Engagement around Data Centers (VOICE-DC)

Position Summary

The AI and Data Infrastructures Learning Lab (AIDILL) in the Department of Learning and Performance Systems seeks an Undergraduate Research Assistant to support the VOICE-DC project, a community-engaged research study examining civic engagement, storytelling, and learning related to AI data center development and governance. The undergraduate assistant will work closely with faculty and graduate researchers to support qualitative research, digital storytelling, and public-facing dissemination efforts. The project investigates how community members use stories, narratives, and other forms of civic participation to understand and shape decisions about emerging technology infrastructure.

Responsibilities

The Undergraduate Research Assistant will:

Produce high-quality manual transcriptions of audio and video recordings from interviews, working groups, and community engagement activities.

Assist with qualitative data organization, file management, and preparation of research materials for analysis.

Create graphics, visualizations, figures, and other research dissemination materials for conference presentations, grant proposals, manuscripts, and public reports.

Support the development and production of project podcasts, including transcription, episode preparation, audio asset organization, and dissemination materials.

Assist with the creation of digital storytelling assets, including story maps, narrative archives, website content, and visual media.

Format and organize photographs, documents, maps, and multimedia materials for public-facing project websites.

Conduct literature searches and assist with citation management as needed.

Participate in research team meetings and contribute to the ongoing development of community-engaged research resources.

Preferred Qualifications

Interest in education, learning sciences, communication, community development, digital humanities, science and technology studies, geography, media studies, or related fields.

Strong attention to detail and ability to produce accurate written transcripts.

Experience with graphic design, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, ArcGIS StoryMaps, website content creation, podcast production, or related digital media tools.

Strong organizational and communication skills.

Ability to work independently while collaborating as part of a research team.

Learning Opportunities

Students will gain experience in:

Qualitative and community-based research methods.

Interview and focus-group data management.

Digital storytelling and public scholarship.

Podcast production and science communication.

Visual communication and research dissemination.

Research on AI, data centers, infrastructure, civic engagement, and community learning.

Expected Deliverables

Completed interview and working-group transcripts.

Graphics and figures for research dissemination.

Podcast production assets.

StoryMap and website content.

Organized digital archive of project materials supporting VOICE-DC public-facing resources.

Application Instructions

Interested applicants should submit the following materials through Workday:

Resume or CV

Include relevant coursework, research experience, employment history, technical skills, and any experience with qualitative research, graphic design, website development, podcast production, or digital storytelling.

Brief Statement of Interest (1 page maximum)

Describe your interest in the position and any relevant experience related to:

Qualitative research

Audio transcription

Graphic design or visual communication

Podcast production

Website development or digital media

Community-engaged research

AI, technology, education, civic engagement, or related topics

List of references (2-3 including name and contact information)

Sample of Relevant Work (Optional but Encouraged)

Applicants may submit one example demonstrating relevant skills, such as:

A graphic, infographic, or design project

Website or digital media content

Podcast or audio project

Research paper

StoryMap or digital storytelling project

Other examples relevant to the position

Selection Criteria

Preference will be given to applicants who demonstrate:

Strong written communication and attention to detail.

Ability to accurately transcribe audio recordings.

Experience creating graphics, figures, or other visual communication products.

Familiarity with digital media tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, ArcGIS StoryMaps, website platforms, audio editing software).

Interest in community-engaged, qualitative, or educational research.

Willingness to complete and maintain all required human subjects research and IRB training and to adhere to approved research protocols throughout the appointment.

Additional Information

This position will provide students with hands-on experience in qualitative research, digital storytelling, science communication, podcast production, website development, and public-facing scholarship through participation in the VOICE-DC (Voices, Outlooks, and Information Networks in Civic Engagement around Data Centers) project. The assistant will contribute to the creation of story maps, podcasts, visual resources, research dissemination products, and community-engaged research materials supporting the AI and Data Infrastructures Learning Lab (AIDILL).

Dabei agieren Sie als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung, Entwicklung und Kunden und begleiten die Produkte über den gesamten Lebenszyklus. Ihr Arbeitsort ist Erlangen-Tennenlohe. Dort sind Sie an mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort. Produktstrategie & Roadmap: Sie entwickeln und pflegen Produktstrategien und Roadmaps in enger Abstimmung mit dem Technical Lead sowie dem Management und setzen diese um. Markt- & Wettbewerbsanalyse: Sie beobachten Markt, Wettbewerb sowie Kundenanforderungen und identifizieren daraus Bedarfe und neue Geschäftspotenziale. Produktvision & Innovation: Sie erkennen Potentiale für Produktverbesserungen und neue Produkte, schätzen Business Cases ab und entwickeln klare Produktvisionen, die Sie für Managemententscheidungen, Entwicklungsteams und Kunden aufbereiten und präsentieren. Steuerung der Produktentwicklung: Sie geben den Entwicklungsteams Orientierung im Entwicklungsprozess, reviewen Entwicklungsstände und stimmen Produktanforderungen iterativ ab. Kunden- & Partnermanagement: Sie identifizieren potenzielle Kunden und Geschäftspartner, bauen nachhaltige Geschäftsbeziehungen auf und entwickeln daraus neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten. Vertrieb & Marketing: Sie verantworten die Planung und Umsetzung von Vertriebs- und Marketingmaßnahmen, entwickeln aussagekräftige Sales Collateral und Präsentationen, organisieren Kundenevents und Messeauftritte. Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master) im Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Elektro- und Informationstechnik, Medientechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Sie verfügen über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und können komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen und verständlich vermitteln. Sie zeichnen unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln aus und haben die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu erkennen und im Blick zu behalten. Sie überzeugen durch ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung , Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie ein sicheres Auftreten bei Kundengesprächen, Produktdemonstrationen und Präsentationen. Sie zeichnen sich durch Eigeninitiative , Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise aus. Sie verfügen über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und bringen die Bereitschaft zu nationalen und internationalen Dienstreisen mit. Eine Affinität zu Audio ist von Vorteil. Spannende Tätigkeit : attraktives Arbeitsumfeld bei einem Weltmarktführer in einer hochinnovativen Schlüsselbranche Praxisbezogene Projekte bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden Gestaltungsfreiraum : Sie motivieren dazu, Innovationen aktiv voranzutreiben und eigene Ideen einzubringen. Engagierte Teams fördern Kreativität und Eigenverantwortung : Hier haben Sie die Freiheit, Ihre Ideen zu entwickeln und aktiv mitzugestalten. Ihre Bedürfnisse nehmen wir ernst : Die bestmögliche Vereinbarkeit Ihres Berufs- und Privatlebens unterstützen wir durch zeitliche Flexibilität und hybrides Arbeiten. Unsere Mitarbeitenden genießen unsere wertschätzende Kultur : Wir sind offen, hilfsbereit und pflegen einen vertrauensvollen Umgang miteinander. Top Ausstattung am Arbeitsplatz : Mit unseren State-of-the-Art Technologien entwickeln wir Lösungen für Herausforderungen der Gegenwart und Zukunft. Ihre Ziele und Interessen liegen uns am Herzen : Wir unterstützen Sie regelmäßig durch fachliche und persönliche Seminare, Coachings sowie Sprachkurse. Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle kann auch in Teilzeit besetzt werden. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet. Eine Verlängerung ist möglich. Anstellung, Vergütung und Sozialleistungen basieren auf dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD). Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. description:

Estimate, organize, and document tasks.

Communicate technical topics both verbally and in written form.

Other duties as assigned.

Pursuing a degree in Audio Recording, Music Technology, or Engineering.

Interest in, and/or experience with, working with professional audio products in live sound, recording or A/V conferencing environments.

Experience with programming languages or scripting languages such as Python or Matlab is highly desirable.

Critical listening skills

Strong verbal and written communications skills

title: Multimodal AI Researcher, Audio
description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a Flex Work approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.

The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) is the research division of the company. ATG’s mission is to look ahead, deliver insights, and innovate technological solutions that will fuel Dolby’s continued growth. Our researchers have a broad range of expertise related to computer science and electrical engineering, such as AI/ML, algorithms, digital signal processing, audio engineering, image processing, computer vision, data science & analytics, distributed systems, cloud, edge & mobile computing, computer networking, and IoT.

Dolby is looking for a talented Senior Multimodal AI Researcher, Audio to join Dolby’s research efforts and drive innovation in multimodal AI for audio applications, multimodal representations, and generative modeling for audio, speech, and music. You will join the Machine Reasoning and Perception team to join a team of top-tier researchers working on challenging problems in multimodal AI for entertainment applications. You will focus on the creation and implementation of multimodal and audio AI technologies from the underlying theoretical concepts to the development of prototypes and demonstrations, with the goal to create new experiences.

You will drive key innovations for Dolby’s core business which allow Dolby and its customers to build products that push the boundaries of sound and multimedia experiences.

Summary

You will push the boundaries of the state-of-the-art in audio and multimodal technologies. The ideal candidate would have a strong background in deep learning, both in terms of conceptual understanding, as well as practical experience, with previous exposure to audio applications. A core aspect of this role involves being able to keep up to date with the literature, implement, and innovate with the bleeding edge in generative models, self-supervised learning, and multi-modal learning.

With the explosion of large language models and natural language processing, you will partner closely with Dolby’s worldwide AI research staff, which actively pursues the integration of such models into audio and media experiences. You will be able to hit the ground running, innovate, and contribute to such projects. Consequently, experience with language models, question answering, vision-language models, captioning, etc. would be highly beneficial.

We are looking for candidates with experience in any of the following:

Generative modeling for audio applications (diffusion models, autoregressive models, masked generative transformers).

Multimodal semantic understanding and multimodal reasoning.

Multimodal representations (audio-video, audio-text, audio-video-text).

Multimodal AI architectures, with a focus on generating audio, music, and speech (text-to-audio, video-to-audio, image-to-audio).

Self and semi-supervised learning.

AI driven audio enhancement, processing, and generation (for speech and music), such as speech enhancement and analysis, source separation, text-to-speech, text-to-music, music information retrieval, audio classification.

LLMs for audio applications.

What You Will Accomplish

Partner closely with other domain experts to refine and execute Dolby’s technical strategy in artificial intelligence and machine learning.

Use deep learning to create new solutions (including foundation models) and enhance existing applications.

Push the state-of-the-art and develop intellectual property.

Transfer technology to product groups.

Establish research collaborations with external university partners.

Mentor interns on novel research problems.

Publish papers in top-tier conferences and journals.

Advise internal leaders on recent deep learning advancements in the industry and academia to further influence research direction and business decisions.

Key Requirements

Ph.D. in Computer Science or similar field.

A strong background in deep learning, both in terms of conceptual understanding, as well as practical experience.

Technical knowledge of audio fundamentals.

Deep passion for audio, music, and multimedia applications.

Deep knowledge on current machine learning literature.

Strong publication record, with publications in major machine learning conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML) or top domain-specific conferences is desirable (e.g., ACL, CVPR, ICASSP, Interspeech).

Highly skilled in Python and one or more popular deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).

Ability to envision new technologies and turn them into innovative products.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Learn more about our innovative research: https://www.dolby.com/about/innovation/empowering/

title: Senior Audio Systems Engineer – Automotive
description:
About Dirac\
Dirac is one of Sweden’s fastest-growing audio tech companies, known for best-in-class technology and a prestigious customer base that includes many of the world’s most reputable brands. We are a global company with headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden, R&D facilities in Copenhagen, Denmark, and Bangalore, India, and representation in Greater China, Germany, Japan, Korea, and the United States. Read more at [https://www.dirac.com/](https://www.dirac.com/)

About the role\
In this role, you will play a key part in growing Dirac in the US and the rest of the Americas. You will drive technical topics with new and existing customers in close collaboration with business development, acting as the primary technical contact, conducting product demonstrations for new opportunities and handling ongoing customer engagements. You will also handle requirements in the RFI/RFQ phases of business development, using your systems engineering expertise to find solutions that align with Dirac’s business goals.\
You will join our international Audio Systems Engineering team, with colleagues in APAC and the EU. You will report to the Audio Systems Engineering Manager.

What you will do

- Tune in-vehicle audio systems

- Design signal chains

- Identify and resolve system-level issues in embedded systems

- Give technical support to our customers

- Provide technical input in the RFI/RFQ process

- Support our sales team in customer meetings and product demonstrations

- Report and track issues

- Write tuning and customer documentation

Over time, you will take technical ownership of several customers. As you grow in the role, you will increasingly contribute to our R&D work and explore new products outside the automotive industry.

What you need\
This is a senior role. We are looking for someone who has mastered the skills below:

- 7+ years of hands-on experience in audio engineering

- Proven experience in the automotive industry

- Bachelor’s degree in acoustics, audio, or electrical engineering, or a related field

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

- A valid driver’s license

- A valid passport and the ability to travel

- Authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a work visa now or in the future

Nice to have

- Experience tuning automotive audio systems

- Experience with agile software development

- Experience at a Tier-1 supplier or car maker (OEM)

- Master’s degree in one of the fields above

Who you are

- You are comfortable presenting in front of customers and groups

- You work independently and make your own decisions

- You are flexible when plans change, and you can travel at short notice

- You are not a salesperson, but you are confident and outgoing with customers

- You are comfortable working in global, cross-functional teams

What Dirac offers you\
At Dirac, we provide a highly entrepreneurial environment where you can be part of a team that is passionate about building a great business and inventing the future of sound. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies that make a real impact on everyday experiences. You’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative agile team that values quality and continuous improvement.\
You will also get:

- To work with major global brands

- Short decision paths. Your ideas and opinions on the product are welcome.

- Talented colleagues in a global organization

- Technical growth in our tools, with chances to work outside the US

- Salary: $90,000–$140,000 per year, depending on experience

Practical information

- Location: Field-based in the Detroit, Michigan area. You must live within commuting distance of Detroit. You will work from a home office between assignments, but this is an active, on-the-move role: much of your time is spent on-site at customer facilities and working in person with our Detroit-based colleague.

- Travel: About 20%, throughout the US and the Americas.

- Customer work: Audio tuning is done in vehicles at customer facilities, so most of your hands-on work happens on-site.

- Physical requirements: Ability to work for extended periods in vehicles and at customer test facilities, and to drive to customer sites.

- Working hours: Daily contact with colleagues in Europe, which means some early mornings.

- Onboarding: 2 weeks at our headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden.

- Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply\
We are interviewing on a continuous basis, so please send your application as soon as possible.

Dirac is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law.

title: Research Engineer
description:
About David AI

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

About our Research team

Our Research team sits at the intersection of cutting-edge research and production systems, transforming raw audio into high-signal data for leading AI labs and enterprises. We own the full ML lifecycle - from researching novel speech processing algorithms to deploying models processing terabytes of audio daily.

About this role

As a Research Engineer at David AI, you'll build algorithms and systems that turn large-scale speech and audio collections into high-quality datasets. You'll tackle questions like: What makes a recording useful? How do we measure and improve dataset quality?

In this role, you will

Design algorithms and metrics using advanced signal processing algorithms and cutting edge ML models with to derive insights from thousands of hours of audio data.

Build scalable data processing pipelines for analyzing, filtering, deduplicating, and curating large speech and audio datasets.

Develop production-grade inference algorithms, pipelines, and APIs with cross-functional teams that unlock key insights into our data for our customers.

Collaborating with our Operations team to gather useful training and evaluation datasets to improve the quality of our models.

Architect systems that enable resilient, durable inference and evaluations.

Your background looks like

3+ years of professional engineering or applied research experience in areas such as data systems, algorithms, applied ML, information retrieval, or speech and audio.

Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable, production-quality software.

End-to-end ownership of ML pipelines, from proof-of-concept to production deployment.

Ability to translate research papers and ideas into high-quality, production-ready code.

Experience deploying ML systems for production inference with cloud technologies.

Ability to assess model quality in the context of user experience and business value.

Bonus points if you have

Experience with speech, audio, or digital signal processing.

Experience with data curation, search and retrieval, embeddings, clustering, deduplication, or sampling.

Experience building model inference systems or integrating pretrained models into production workflows.

Experience in publishing in top conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, etc.

Experience in releasing, maintaining, contributing to open-source softwares.

PhD or Masters in Computer Science or a related field.

Benefits

Unlimited PTO.

Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.

FSA & HSA access.

401k access.

Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.

Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

Visas

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers , H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

title: Senior DSP Engineer
description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

At Bose, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth. We bring together research, engineering, and a passion for audio to create experiences that people love. Join us to turn advanced signal processing into reliable, reusable technology that reaches products across multiple platforms and form factors.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior DSP Engineer to develop, port, optimize, integrate, and validate audio signal processing software for embedded platforms. You will independently own substantial DSP components or workstreams, taking algorithms from reference models through production deployment.

You will turn MATLAB/Simulink models and research implementations into robust C/C++ components that can be reused across audio products. The work combines practical DSP engineering, target optimization, and hands-on integration, with an emphasis on audio quality, testability, and maintainability.

This role is working closely with algorithm, systems, firmware, hardware, and QA teams. You will learn and work within Bose’s proprietary audio technologies and collaborate with ML and ANC/ANR engineers as needed.

Key Responsibilities

Implement, port, and validate DSP algorithms for embedded audio applications, translating reference models into production-quality C/C++.

Independently own DSP components from implementation planning through integration, verification, and release, while communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs.

Develop modular, reusable processing blocks and integrate them into configurable audio chains and embedded frameworks.

Apply fixed-point and floating-point techniques, selecting appropriate numerical representations and validating behavior against reference models.

Profile and optimize compute, memory, latency, and real-time performance on DSP and embedded targets such as Cadence HiFi, ARM, and Qualcomm Hexagon.

Build unit tests, reference test vectors, and automated regression tests, documenting numerical accuracy, audio behavior, and target performance.

Debug algorithm and system integration issues on reference and product hardware using lab equipment, debuggers, and profiling tools.

Collaborate with firmware engineers on interfaces, build environments, and integration dependencies, adapting implementations as requirements evolve.

Contribute to design and code reviews, maintain clear technical documentation, and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

5+ years of relevant DSP or embedded software development experience, with substantial hands-on DSP implementation work.

Strong DSP fundamentals and practical experience implementing signal processing algorithms for embedded or real-time systems.

Strong C/C++ programming skills and MATLAB/Simulink experience for algorithm analysis, modeling, and validation.

Experience implementing fixed-point and floating-point algorithms and evaluating numerical accuracy and hardware trade-offs.

Hands-on development experience with at least one relevant DSP or embedded processor architecture, such as Cadence HiFi, ARM, or Qualcomm Hexagon.

Demonstrated ability to independently take DSP components through implementation, optimization, integration, and validation.

Strong debugging and profiling skills, with experience diagnosing performance, memory, and real-time processing issues.

Experience with automated testing, version control, code reviews, and clear engineering documentation.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work onsite in Framingham, MA.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline.

Experience with audio DSP, including equalization, dynamics processing, filtering, sample-rate conversion, spatial audio, or voice processing.

Processor-specific optimization using SIMD/vector intrinsics or assembly, including Cadence HiFi, ARM Neon/Helium, Qualcomm Hexagon, or x64 SIMD.

Experience developing reusable DSP libraries and integrating low-latency audio processing into RTOS or embedded Linux systems.

Experience with Embedded Coder or similar code-generation tools, Python-based validation, or continuous integration.

Experience deploying ML algorithms or partnering with ANC/ANR controls engineers.

title: Embedded Software Engineer, Platform
description:
About Hark

Hark is an artificial intelligence company building advanced, personalized intelligence. One that is proactive, multimodal, and capable of interacting with the world through speech, text, vision, and persistent memory.

We're pairing that intelligence with next-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world.

To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next-generation AI hardware together - designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems.

About the Role

The Embedded Software team owns the software running on Hark’s next generation of AI hardware, and we are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer, Platform to own the OS platform layer of it. You will design, configure, maintain, and optimize the OS platform services, the user space services and daemons above them, and the protocols that connect the device to our backend.

This is the platform end of the embedded spectrum: services, frameworks, virtualization, and protocol work on top of a complex multi-core SoC, in addition to driver and MCU work. You will partner closely with the BSP, embedded software, UX, and backend teams, and with the AI teams whose models run on the platform you build.

Responsibilities

Design, configure, maintain, and optimize the OS platform services on Hark devices

Build system services and daemons, frameworks, and networking primitives and protocols

Own backend integrations, including protocol design and the performance analysis behind it

Build and maintain virtualization frameworks and multi-OS system design, with the performance analysis to back it

Profile and tune the platform for performance and power across the full multi-core system

Partner with BSP, embedded software, UX, and backend teams so platform services, device software, and services land together

Requirements

5+ years of professional embedded software development experience on shipping hardware products

Proficiency in C, C++, or Rust

Deep understanding of computer architecture and operating system fundamentals

Experience building OS services, frameworks and platform software on embedded systems

Experience with one or more of: Unix or BSD Linux, VxWorks, QNX, or other modern operating systems

Experience with performance and power optimization

Familiarity with open source IoT frameworks such as MQTT, RabbitMQ, or CoAP

Experience building systems on modern,, multi-core SoCs

Familiarity with embedded toolchains and cross-compilation

Bonus Qualifications

Experience with networking and connectivity, including wireless stacks

Experience with constrained system architectures and MCUs

Experience with hardware accelerators and inference runtimes (e.g. ONNX, TensorFlow)

Experience with agentic frameworks

Linux kernel contributions or deep kernel-adjacent platform work

Development experience with DSP audio or camera ISP

Compensation

The US base salary range for this full-time position is between $120,000 - $300,000 annually.

The pay offered for this position may vary based on several individual factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package may also include additional components/benefits depending on the specific role. This information will be shared if an employment offer is extended.

Ability to work across cross‑functional and geographically distributed teams.

title: Senior Lead Consultant, Acoustics
description:

Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex policy issues? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health Department as our new Senior Lead Consultant in Acoustics and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

As our new Senior Lead Consultant in Acoustics, you will meet the expanding environmental noise and vibration assessment needs of clients across various sectors – including infrastructure, renewable energy, ports, transportation, and data centers. You will be part of a dynamic team providing state-of-the-art scientific, technical, and strategic risk management knowledge to an international client base.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Leading projects involving environmental noise assessments, noise mitigation design, and acoustical specification

Completing project noise analyses that include acoustical modeling (CadnaA, Sound Plan, or similar) and mitigation design/specification

Leading sound level surveys and related field work in a range of environments from busy urban areas to remote locations

Critically reviewing and interpreting local, state, provincial, and federal environmental regulations affecting the siting, design, construction, and operation of projects

Preparing reports and communicating results to clients

Growing client relationships

Your new team

You will be part of the Environment & Health division, Ramboll develops innovative, scientifically sound solutions that help increase livability by reducing pollution and restoring natural environments. One of the world’s leading environmental and health consultancies, our bright minds are trusted by clients to manage their most challenging environmental, health and social issues.

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

About you

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. While we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success.

These include:

B.S. or M.S. in Engineering, Science, Mathematics, or a related field.

6+ years of acoustical consulting experience, preferably focused on environmental noise assessments.

Proficiency with environmental acoustical modeling software and Microsoft Office applications.

Strong written and verbal communication, analytical, and organizational skills.

Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply environmental regulations, work independently at remote job sites, and collaborate effectively with a team.
